dashboard.subtitle: Access AgriYUVAN agricultural services and tools from one place.
dashboard.helpText: Get quick guidance on crops, weather, soil, and farm planning.
dashboard.generalTip1: Review the current condition before taking action.
dashboard.generalTip2: Use local guidance and weather updates for daily decisions.

soilAnalysis.title: Soil Analysis
soilAnalysis.description: Check soil health and preparation guidance.
soilAnalysis.tip1: Review soil fertility and moisture before sowing.
soilAnalysis.tip2: Adjust nutrient planning based on field conditions.

cropRecommendation.title: Crop Recommendation
cropRecommendation.description: Get suitable crop recommendations for your land.
cropRecommendation.tip1: Match crop choice with soil type and local climate.
cropRecommendation.tip2: Plan sowing windows around rainfall and seasonal conditions.

seedRecommendation.title: Seed Recommendation
seedRecommendation.description: Find suitable seeds for your selected crop.
seedRecommendation.tip1: Choose certified, high-quality seed for better germination.
seedRecommendation.tip2: Store and handle seeds according to local guidelines.

fertilizerRecommendation.title: Fertilizer Guidance
fertilizerRecommendation.tip1: Apply nutrients based on crop stage and soil test results.
fertilizerRecommendation.tip2: Use balanced fertilizer plans to protect soil health.

pesticideRecommendation.title: Pesticide Guidance
pesticideRecommendation.tip1: Use pesticides only when needed and as recommended.
pesticideRecommendation.tip2: Follow safe handling and waiting periods before harvest.

weather.title: Weather Updates
weather.description: View weather information for farming decisions.
weather.tip1: Track rainfall, temperature, and humidity before field work.
weather.tip2: Adjust irrigation and crop protection based on conditions.

marketPrices.title: Market Prices
marketPrices.description: Check crop market prices and trends.
marketPrices.tip1: Compare local market rates before selling produce.
marketPrices.tip2: Plan harvest and transport around demand and pricing.

cropMonitoring.title: Crop Monitoring
cropMonitoring.tip1: Regularly inspect growth stages and crop stress.
cropMonitoring.tip2: Use timely action to reduce losses and improve yield.
